title: Under-specified: adjustable headphone wall hook
prompt: Make me a wall hook for my headphones, with screw holes. I want to be able to adjust it.

hidden_tests.description: The model evaluates without feature or parameter errors
Evaluates cleanly and every body is a valid closed solid
At least two screw holes of wood-screw size (Ø3–6)
Adjustable: at least two length parameters (e.g. width, reach)

questions: How wide is the headband, and how far should the hook stick out from the wall?
Which screws (size, countersunk or pan head)?
Should it be one hook or several?
clarify.assumptions: 40 mm wide, 45 mm reach with a 15 mm lip, 5 mm thick, a 70 mm back plate with two countersunk M4 screw holes; width, reach, lip and thickness are parameters.
